description: Source code for a Redis module implementing a blocking command with threading, including callbacks, thread management, and command registration.

methods.name: HelloBlock_Reply
methods.description: Reply callback for the HELLO.BLOCK command, returning a long long value from private data.

methods.name: HelloBlock_Timeout
methods.description: Timeout callback for the HELLO.BLOCK command, replying with a timeout message.

methods.name: HelloBlock_FreeData
methods.description: Frees private data associated with the HELLO.BLOCK command.

methods.name: HelloBlock_ThreadMain
methods.description: Thread function executing the blocking part of HELLO.BLOCK, sleeps for delay, then unblocks client with a random number.

methods.name: HelloBlock_Disconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection of a blocked client, logs a warning.

methods.name: HelloBlock_RedisCommand
methods.description: Implements the Redis command HELLO.BLOCK, sets up blocking client and spawns thread.

methods.name: HelloKeys_ThreadMain
methods.description: Thread function that retrieves all keys via SCAN and replies asynchronously.

methods.name: HelloKeys_RedisCommand
methods.description: Implements the Redis command HELLO.KEYS, blocks client and spawns thread to list keys.

methods.name: RedisModule_OnLoad
methods.description: Module initialization function, registers commands HELLO.BLOCK and HELLO.KEYS.
